posts.zh:
dsh-niao-quick-open 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fd5b6d98b003bf1e833a.html
posts.en:
dsh-niao-quick-open is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fd5b6d98b003bf1e833a.html
